"""Strict, lossless, separately scoped component-control observation."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import sys
import time
import unittest

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
parser.add_argument('--manifest', required=True, type=Path)
parser.add_argument('--tests', nargs='+', default=['tests.test_hia_machine_plan_native'])
parser.add_argument('--expected', type=int, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = BASE / 'source'
OUT = args.output.resolve()
OUT.mkdir(mode=0o700)
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
os.environ['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
os.environ['HEPTA_HIA_MACHINE_PLAN_DEVELOPMENT_MANIFEST'] = str(args.manifest.resolve())
os.environ['HEPTA_HIA_MACHINE_PLAN_FIXTURE_EVIDENCE'] = str(OUT / 'fixture')
assert not os.environ.get('HEPTA_HIA_MACHINE_PLAN_COLD_REPORT')

def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def snapshot():
    return {p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): {'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(p.read_bytes())}
            for p in sorted(ROOT.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts}

def save(name, value):
    (OUT / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')

before = snapshot()
manifest_bytes = args.manifest.read_bytes()
manifest = json.loads(manifest_bytes)
image = args.manifest.parent / manifest['image_path']
image_bytes = image.read_bytes()
save('source-before.json', before)
save('environment.json', {'python': sys.version, 'executable': sys.executable,
     'platform': platform.platform(), 'scope': 'EXPLICIT_RETAINED_COMPILER_DEVELOPMENT',
     'manifest': str(args.manifest), 'manifest_sha256': sha(manifest_bytes),
     'image_sha256': sha(image_bytes), 'current_cold': False})
names = []
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(args.tests)

def ids(suite):
    for item in suite:
        if isinstance(item, unittest.TestSuite):
            yield from ids(item)
        else:
            yield item.id()

loaded = list(ids(suite))
assert len(loaded) == args.expected and len(set(loaded)) == len(loaded), loaded
save('loaded-test-ids.json', loaded)

class Result(unittest.TextTestResult):
    def startTest(self, test):
        names.append(test.id())
        super().startTest(test)

start = time.monotonic_ns()
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2, resultclass=Result).run(suite)
elapsed = time.monotonic_ns() - start
after = snapshot()
save('source-after.json', after)
unchanged = before == after and args.manifest.read_bytes() == manifest_bytes and image.read_bytes() == image_bytes
success = (result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun == args.expected and names == loaded
           and not result.skipped and not result.expectedFailures and not result.unexpectedSuccesses
           and unchanged)
bridge = sys.modules.get('hepta.hia_machine_plan_control_native')
unknown = 0 if bridge is None else len(bridge._UNCONFIRMED_RETIREMENTS)
native_tests = sys.modules.get('tests.test_hia_machine_plan_native')
owner = None if native_tests is None else getattr(native_tests.MachinePlanNativeTests, 'native', None)
report = {'status': 'PASS' if success else 'FAIL', 'scope': 'COMPONENT_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY',
          'loaded': loaded, 'executed': names, 'tests_run': result.testsRun,
          'errors': [(x.id(), text) for x, text in result.errors],
          'failures': [(x.id(), text) for x, text in result.failures],
          'skips': [(x.id(), text) for x, text in result.skipped],
          'expected_failures': [(x.id(), text) for x, text in result.expectedFailures],
          'unexpected_successes': [x.id() for x in result.unexpectedSuccesses],
          'source_and_inputs_unchanged': unchanged, 'elapsed_ns': elapsed,
          'native_entries_parent_only': None if owner is None else owner.entries,
          'unknown_retirement_count': unknown, 'manifest': manifest,
          'current_cold': False, 'whole_backend_qualified': False}
save('RESULT.json', report)
print(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True, indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if success else 1)
